number: # The skills of a pack. The numbers 1 to 100 are the skills of skills.md (guide book p.254, p.255). A pack can add rows after 100.
# traits: the behaviours of the code that the skill gives, with | between them (docs/SKILLS.md has the list). - = no trait.
# A skill with no trait gets its behaviour from a table that names its number: critical_skills.tsv, plot_skills.tsv, plots.tsv, terrain.tsv or disasters.tsv.
# An officer has one skill (officers.tsv, column skill). To give a behaviour to another officer, give that officer the skill, or add a row with the same traits.
# file_id: the skill byte of a scenario or save record (officer +124). The order of the file is not the order of the book.
# The clone matched the holders of skills.md against the bytes of spec/fixtures/scenarios/SCEN002.s11 (2026-10-22): 97 numbers agree,
# no byte has two numbers. 35, 41 and 61 have no holder; their ids 42, 48 and 60 follow from the order of their neighbours (assumed).
